svg.title: Relationship between a Git repository, the DVC cache, GitHub, and an RDS DVC remote
svg.desc: The host computer contains both the working Git repository and the local DVC cache. Git synchronises source code and DVC metadata with GitHub. DVC moves large data between the local cache and remote RDS storage, and checks cached data into the repository working directory.
svg.text: How Git and DVC store a reproducible project
Code and metadata travel through Git; large data travel through DVC.
Both the repository and DVC cache are local to the researcher’s computer
A Git commit records the DVC pointer; the matching data are recovered from RDS through the local cache.
